component.name: SearchView
component.script:
sub init() m.kbd = m.top.findNode("kbd") m.top.keyboard = m.kbd if m.global.focusInInit then m.kbd.setFocus(true) m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onScreenFocusChange") end sub
sub onScreenFocusChange() if m.top.hasFocus() then print " screen has the focus: background reset, forwarding to the keyboard" m.kbd.setFocus(true) end if end sub
